scope: WO application itself published by 2017-12-31; PI; CN applicant address; earliest filing 2013-2017; existing five broad IPCs; main-group attribution; retrospective current edition

interpretation: 2017 filing cohorts are heavily right-truncated when own WO publication must predate 2018. Counts are main-group-family memberships, not all-China unique families. Initial zero support is not evidence of zero innovation.
